test_title: PYST 19: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 18 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The Constitution (One Hundred and Twenty-Ninth Amendment) Bill, introduced in the Lok Sabha on 17 December 2024, seeks to empower:

options.text: the Parliament to make laws to deal with anti-national activities
the State to make any special provision for the advancement of the economically weaker section (EWS) of citizens
the President to declare different proclamations of national emergency on different grounds simultaneously
the Election Commission to conduct elections for Lok Sabha and all State Assemblies at the same time

solution:
The correct answer is__** the Election Commission to conduct elections for Lok Sabha and all State Assemblies at the same time**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Purpose:** Enables **simultaneous elections** to the **Lok Sabha** and all **State Legislative Assemblies**.
 
• **Empowering Authority:** **Election Commission of India (ECI)** is authorized to **synchronize elections**.
 
• **Reason:** Reduces **frequent elections**, **administrative costs**, and **political disruptions**, supporting the **“One Nation, One Election”** concept.
 
• **Scope:** Applies to **all States and Union Territories with Legislative Assemblies.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **103rd Constitutional Amendment:**

 
 
• The **103rd Amendment** to the Constitution introduced a **10% reservation** for **economically weaker sections (EWS)** of the general category in **government jobs and educational institutions**.
 
• This reservation was applicable to individuals who did not fall under the SC, ST, or OBC categories and met the prescribed income and asset criteria.
 
• It added two new clauses in **Article 15(6)** and **Article 16(6)** to provide reservation for EWS categories.
 
 
 
• **Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) Criteria:**
 
 
• Individuals with a family income of less than **Rs. 8 lakh per annum** are considered EWS.
 
• Exclusions include those owning agricultural land of more than **5 acres**, a residential flat of more than **1000 sq. ft**, or a residential plot of specific dimensions as per criteria.
 
 
 
• **Reservation Policy in India:**
 
 
• India follows a reservation system to ensure social justice for marginalized communities such as SCs, STs, and OBCs.
 
• The EWS reservation is a significant step towards addressing economic disparities beyond caste-based considerations.
 
 
 
• **Articles Related to Reservation in India:**
 
 
• **Article 15:** Prohibits discrimination on grounds of religion, race, caste, sex, or place of birth.
 
• **Article 16:** Provides for equality of opportunity in matters of public employment.
 
• The 103rd Amendment added the sub-clauses (6) to both of these articles to accommodate EWS reservation.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Implementation of EWS Reservation:**

 
 
• The reservation for EWS is applicable in **central government jobs** and admission to educational institutions.
 
• Many states have adopted the EWS reservation policy in their respective jurisdictions as well.
 
 
 
• **Supreme Court Verdict:**
 
 
• The **Supreme Court** upheld the constitutional validity of the 103rd Amendment in November 2022, ensuring the continuity of EWS reservations.
 
• The court ruled that the amendment does not violate the basic structure of the Constitution.
 
 
 
• **Global Context:**
 
 
• Many countries have affirmative action policies for economically or socially disadvantaged groups, such as the **United States** and **South Africa**.
 
• India's EWS reservation is considered a pioneering step in addressing economic inequality through affirmative action.
